method: Both actual rendered PNGs inspected with view_image; final convergence figure re-inspected after disabling y-axis numerical offset.
checks: All parameter labels, markers, interval endpoints and x-axis labels visible without clipping or overlap
Zero-reference line and unresolved intervals retained; incomplete controls excluded only from equal-budget plot
Convergence uses descriptive medians and IQR, not confidence bands
Seed scatter uses identical completed distinct budgets; attempted-query axis is logarithmic
Final convergence y-axis displays actual service-loss values rather than a hidden +33 offset
Figure captions explain units, seed replication and postvalidation status
